title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1973-03-28

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard captures a tight March ’73 performance highlighted by an expansive Workingman's Prelude → Dark Star → Eyes → Playin’ sequence, though the audience‑only sections are muddy.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised for its tight playing and a monster Dark Star/Playin’ stretch that many reviewers call masterful. The third disc’s soundboard source is excellent, but listeners should skip the audience‑recorded portions because of muffled, uneven quality. Overall it’s a standout early‑73 concert worth hunting down for the SBD tracks.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight exceptional Dark Star/Playin’ performances; recording is praised for the soundboard portion but audience sections are noted as problematic, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Disc 3 (WRS Prelude through JB Goode) is a clean soundboard capture; the surrounding audience recordings are described as muddy, having drop‑outs and other issues, so selective listening is advised.

standout_songs: Workingman's Prelude → Dark Star → Eyes → Playin'
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as tight and well‑structured, with the Workingman's Prelude leading into a long, exploratory Dark Star that seamlessly morphs into Eyes and Playin’, providing one of the show’s high points.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers rave about Jerry’s soaring guitar tone, his “musical inspiration” on Dark Star, and note his use of a Crybaby wah‑wah pedal.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil is singled out for “amazing notes” during the wide‑open Dark Star jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s volume‑pedal piano work is mentioned; no specific comments on other keyboardists.
